# Indicator Calculation 

## Global MPI

```{r}

#recode uuid

main$uuid <- main$"_uuid"
RA_adult$uuid <- RA_adult$"_uuid" 
RA_caregiver$uuid <- RA_caregiver$"_uuid"
RA_woman$uuid <- RA_woman$"_uuid"
HHroster$uuid <- HHroster$"_uuid"

### Global MPI for Zambia

##Education dimension ----


###Years of schooling---


#Years of schooling	No eligible household member has completed six years of schooling.	
#1/6	SDG 4:Quality Education

###Details: 
#If all individuals in the household are in an age group where they should have formally completed 6 or more years of schooling,
#but none have this achievement, then the household is deprived. However, if any individuals aged 10 years and older reported 6
#years or more of schooling, the household is not deprived.

#The educational system in Cameroon is divided into primary (six years, compulsive)


summary(HHroster$agetouse) # Age of the individual

table(HHroster$primary_complete) #If an individual has completed primary school


HHroster <- HHroster %>%
  mutate(
    mpi_edu_schooling = case_when(
      agetouse >= 10 & primary_complete == 1 ~ 1, #primary complete above 10
      agetouse >= 10 & primary_complete == 0 ~ 0)) # deprived 

table(HHroster$mpi_edu_schooling)

##merge into main if there at least 1 HH member with primary school education complete

#code as 1 if deprived

table(HHroster$uuid)
table(main$uuid)

edu_schooling_mpi <- HHroster %>%
  group_by(uuid) %>%
  summarise(mpi_edu_schooling_any = as.integer(!any(mpi_edu_schooling == 1, na.rm = TRUE)))

main <- main %>%
  left_join(edu_schooling_mpi, by = "uuid")

table(main$mpi_edu_schooling_any)

#School attendance	Any school-aged child is not attending school up to the age at which 
#he/she would complete class 8.	1/6	SDG 4:Quality Education

##https://isced.uis.unesco.org/wp-content/uploads/sites/15/uis_isced_uploads/b81565285afa129ad02672e2b45653cc.jpg - school attendance age for Zambia 7 to 13 (inclusive)
#agetouse is the age for HHroster


table(HHroster$HH_Educ02a) # Are you currently going to school?  If it is school holiday between two school years, tell us about the last school year.Do not include kindergarten or preschool.

HHroster <- HHroster %>%
  mutate(
    mpi_edu_notattending = case_when(
      (agetouse >= 7 & agetouse <= 14) &
        HH_Educ02a==1 ~ 0,  # attending (or completed)
      (agetouse >= 7 & agetouse <= 14) &
        HH_Educ02a==2 ~ 1   # not attending
    )
  )

table(HHroster$mpi_edu_notattending)

##merge into main if there at least 1 child not attending

edu_attending_mpi <- HHroster %>%
  group_by(uuid) %>%
  summarise(mpi_edu_notattending_any = as.integer(any(mpi_edu_notattending == 1, na.rm = TRUE)))

main <- main %>%
  left_join(edu_attending_mpi, by = "uuid")

table(main$mpi_edu_notattending_any)

####Health-----



#Nutrition	Any person under 70 years of age for whom there is nutritional information is undernourished.	1/6	SDG 2: Zero Hunger

##Using if they have poor consumption score


###Add also children 0-5 if they are undernourished

#Children under 5 years (60 months and younger) are considered undernourished if their z-score of either height-for-age (stunting)
#or weight-for-age (underweight) is below minus two standard deviations from the median of the reference population




RA_caregiver <- RA_caregiver %>%
  mutate(
    mpi_stunting= case_when(
      C020201==1 ~ 1  # undernourished child
    )
  )

health_undernourished <- RA_caregiver %>%
  group_by(uuid) %>%
  summarise(health_undernourished_any = as.integer(any(mpi_stunting == 1, na.rm = TRUE)))


table(health_undernourished$health_undernourished_any)

main <- main %>%
  left_join(health_undernourished, by = "uuid")


main <- main %>%
  mutate(
    health_undernourished_any = replace_na(health_undernourished_any, 0)
  )




table(main$health_undernourished_any)
table(main$FCSCat28)



main <- main %>%
  mutate(
    mpi_foodunder = case_when(
      FCSCat28 == "Poor" | health_undernourished_any == 1 ~ 1,
      FCSCat28 %in% c("Borderline", "Acceptable") & health_undernourished_any == 0 ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_  # For any other combination including missing values
    )
  )

table(main$mpi_foodunder, useNA = "ifany")




#Child mortality	A child under 18 has died in the household in the five-year period preceding the survey.	1/6	SDG 3: Health and Well-being
##Using antenatal care instead
#Deprived if any woman in the household who has given birth in the last 3 years did not receive antenatal
#check-ups (households with no woman who has given birth are considered non-deprived)

table(RA_woman$BA4)


RA_woman <- RA_woman %>%
  mutate(
    mpi_health_antenatal= case_when(
      BA4==2 ~ 1  # deprived from antenatal care
    )
  )

health_antenatal_mpi <- RA_woman %>%
  group_by(uuid) %>%
  summarise(health_antenatal_mpi_any = as.integer(any(mpi_health_antenatal == 1, na.rm = TRUE)))


table(health_antenatal_mpi$health_antenatal_mpi_any)

main <- main %>%
  left_join(health_antenatal_mpi, by = "uuid")


table(main$health_antenatal_mpi_any)

####Standard of living





###Cooking fuel	

###A household cooks using solid fuel, such as dung, agricultural crop, shrubs, wood, charcoal, 
#or coal.	1/18	SDG 7: Affordable and Clean Energy

###Cooking fuel----

#Deprived if the household uses solid cooking fuels for cooking (wood, dung cakes, crop residue, 
#coal/charcoal, other)

table(main$HC02)

#coo	1	Solar cooker (thermal energy,not solar panels)
#coo	2	Electric stove
#coo	3	Piped natural gas stove
#coo	4	Biogas stove
#coo	5	Liquefied petroleum gas (LPG)/cooking gas stove
#coo	6	Manufactured solid fuel stove
#coo	7	Traditional solid fuel stove (non-manufactured)
#coo	8	Liquid fuel stove
#coo	9	Moveable firepan
#coo	10	Three stone stove/open fire
#coo	11	Build stove with bricks and/ormud
#coo	11	No other devices used for cooking
#coo	96	Other, specify


main <- main %>%
  mutate(
    mpi_solidcooking= case_when(
      HC02 %in% c(6,7,9,10,11,96) ~ 1, # DEPRIVED
      TRUE ~ 0,
    )
  )

table(main$mpi_solidcooking)


###Sanitation	

####The household has unimproved or no sanitation facility or it is improved but 
#shared with other households.	1/18	SDG 6:Clean Water and Sanitation


table(main$type_san_facility) ##improved sanitation facility
table(main$shared_san_facility) ##shared toilet

main <- main %>%
  mutate(
    mpi_noimprovedtoilet= case_when(
      type_san_facility==1 & shared_san_facility ==1 ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ 0
    )
  )

table(main$mpi_noimprovedtoilet)


###Drinking water	

##The household’s source of drinking water is not safe or safe drinking water is 
#a 30-minute or longer walk from home, roundtrip.	1/18	SDG 6:Clean Water and Sanitation


##Deprived if the household has no access to an improved source of water according to MDG standards,
#considering distance (less than a 30-minute return trip): tap water, hand pump, motor pump, protected well, mineral water

table(main$Improved_dw_final)

###recode this for deprivation


main <- main %>%
  mutate(
    mpi_nodrinkingwater= case_when(
      Improved_dw_final==0 ~ 1,
      Improved_dw_final==1 ~ 0
    )
  )

table(main$mpi_nodrinkingwater)



###Electricity	
###The household has no electricity.	1/18	SDG 7: Affordable and Clean Energy


table(main$electricity) ## hh has electricity

table(main$HE01) #What source of electricity is used **most** of the time in this household?

#response options

#HE01	0	No electricity in household
#HE01	1	National grid connection from (Company)
#HE01	2	Local mini grid
#HE01	3	Solar home system
#3HE01	4	Solar lantern
#HE01	5	Electric generator
#HE01	6	Rechargeable battery
#HE01	7	Dry cell battery/torch
#HE01	96	Other: specify




main <- main %>%
  mutate(
    mpi_noelectricity= case_when(
      HE01 %in% c(0,7,96) ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ 0
    )
  )

table(main$mpi_noelectricity)

###Housing	The household has inadequate housing materials in any of the three components: 
##floor, roof, or walls.	1/18	SDG 11: Sustainable Cities and Communities


main <- main %>%
  mutate(
    HH02_WI = case_when(
      HH02 %in% c(11, 12, 13) ~ "natural",
      HH02 %in% c(21, 22, 23, 24, 25, 26, 50) ~ "rudimentary",
      HH02 %in% c(31, 32, 33, 34, 35, 36) ~ "finished",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    HH03_WI = case_when(
      HH03 %in% c(11, 12, 13) ~ "natural",
      HH03 %in% c(21, 22, 23, 24) ~ "rudimentary",
      HH03 %in% c(31, 32, 33, 34, 35, 36) ~ "finished",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    HH06_WI = case_when(
      HH06 %in% c(11, 12) ~ "natural",
      HH06 %in% c(21, 22) ~ "rudimentary",
      HH06 %in% c(31, 32, 33, 34, 35, 36) ~ "finished",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    HH02_finished = case_when(HH02_WI == "finished" ~ 1, TRUE ~ 0),
    HH03_finished = case_when(HH03_WI == "finished" ~ 1, TRUE ~ 0),
    HH06_finished = case_when(HH06_WI == "finished" ~ 1, TRUE ~ 0)
  )

sum(is.na(main$HH02_finished)) #WALLS
sum(is.na(main$HH03_finished)) #ROOF
sum(is.na(main$HH06_finished)) #Floor



#inadequate flooring, usually "natural" and "rudimentary" are considered inadequate, while "finished" is adequate.
table(main$HH02_WI)
table(main$HH03_WI)
table(main$HH06_WI)

####Deprived if floor is made of natural materials or if dwelling has no roof or walls or if either the roof or walls are constructed using
#natural or rudimentary materials. 
#The definition of natural and rudimentary materials follows the classification used in country specific DHS or MICS questionnaires.

main$mpi_housing <- ifelse(
  main$HH02_WI %in% c("natural", "rudimentary") |
    main$HH03_WI  %in% c("natural", "rudimentary") |
    main$HH06_WI  %in% c("natural"),
  1,  # deprived
  0   # not deprived
)

table(main$mpi_housing)

###Assets	

#The household does not own more than one of these assets: radio, TV, telephone, computer, 
#animal cart, bicycle, motorbike, or refrigerator, and does not own a car or truck.	1/18	SDG 1:No Poverty



##No more than two 



table(main$Assets01) # radio -- use
table(main$Assets01b) # television --use
table(main$Assets02l) #a laptop -- use
table(main$Assets02b) #mobile phone -- use
table(main$Assets02c) #smart phone -- use
table(main$Assets02d) #bicycle -- use
table(main$Assets02i) #animal-cart
table(main$Assets02d) # bicycle
table(main$Assets02e) # motorbike
table(main$Assets01d) # refrigerator 
table(main$Assets02f_a) # car
table(main$Assets02f_b) # truck

# Strip labels before using them in conditions
main$Assets01    <- as.numeric(main$Assets01)
main$Assets01b   <- as.numeric(main$Assets01b)
main$Assets02b   <- as.numeric(main$Assets02b)
main$Assets02c   <- as.numeric(main$Assets02c)
main$Assets02l   <- as.numeric(main$Assets02l)
main$Assets02i   <- as.numeric(main$Assets02i)
main$Assets02d   <- as.numeric(main$Assets02d)
main$Assets02e   <- as.numeric(main$Assets02e)
main$Assets01d   <- as.numeric(main$Assets01d)
main$Assets02f_a <- as.numeric(main$Assets02f_a)
main$Assets02f_b <- as.numeric(main$Assets02f_b)


str(main$Assets01)
# Create 1 variable for telephone ownership (mobile OR smart phone)
main$owns_telephone <- ifelse(main$Assets02b == 1 | main$Assets02c == 1, 1, 0)

# Now count ownership across the 8 assets (telephone is now 1 variable)
main$asset_count <- (
  (main$Assets01 == 1) +    # radio
    (main$Assets01b == 1) +   # TV
    main$owns_telephone +     # telephone (already simplified above)
    (main$Assets02l == 1) +   # computer
    (main$Assets02i == 1) +   # animal cart
    (main$Assets02d == 1) +   # bicycle
    (main$Assets02e == 1) +   # motorbike
    (main$Assets01d == 1)     # refrigerator
)

table(main$asset_count)

# Flag deprivation: at most 1 of the 8 + does not own car/truck
main$asset_deprived <- main$asset_count <= 1 & 
  main$Assets02f_a != 1 & 
  main$Assets02f_b != 1

table(main$asset_deprived)

main$mpi_assets <- ifelse(main$asset_deprived == FALSE, 0, 1)

table(main$mpi_assets) ##ASSETS DEPRIVED max 1 asset no car/no truck


#####



main <- main %>%
  mutate(
    health_antenatal_mpi_any = replace_na(health_antenatal_mpi_any, 0)
  )



table(main$mpi_edu_schooling_any) # no adult with schooling- weight 1/6
table(main$mpi_edu_notattending_any) # child not attending school 1/6

table(main$mpi_foodunder) # HH has poor food consumption 1/6
table(main$health_antenatal_mpi_any) # no antenatal care 1/6 ( instead of child mortality)


###Standards of living

table(main$mpi_nodrinkingwater) #1/18
table(main$mpi_noimprovedtoilet) #1/18
table(main$mpi_housing) #1/18
table(main$mpi_noelectricity) #1/18
table(main$mpi_solidcooking) #1/18
table(main$mpi_assets) #1/18



# Education dimensions
main$edu_schooling <- main$mpi_edu_schooling_any * (1/6)
main$edu_attendance <- main$mpi_edu_notattending_any * (1/6)

# Health dimensions
main$health_foodunder <- main$mpi_foodunder * (1/6)
main$health_antenatal <- main$health_antenatal_mpi_any * (1/6)


# Living standards
main$nodrinkingwater <- main$mpi_nodrinkingwater * (1/18)
main$noimprovedtoilet <- main$mpi_noimprovedtoilet * (1/18)
main$noimprovedwalls <- main$mpi_housing * (1/18)
main$noelectricity <- main$mpi_noelectricity * (1/18)
main$solidcooking <- main$mpi_solidcooking * (1/18)
main$assets <- main$mpi_assets * (1/18)

# Total deprivation score per household
main$mpi_score <- main$edu_schooling + main$edu_attendance + 
   main$health_antenatal + main$health_foodunder +
  main$nodrinkingwater + main$noimprovedtoilet + main$noimprovedwalls +
  main$noelectricity + main$solidcooking + main$assets 

# MPI incidence (headcount ratio) (H)
main$mpi_poor <- main$mpi_score >= 1/3
main$mpi_incidence <- mean(main$mpi_poor, na.rm = TRUE)

table(main$mpi_incidence)


#### 1. Incidence (H) – "How many are poor?"
#Definition: The proportion of people (or households) who are multidimensionally poor.
#A person is poor if their weighted deprivation score is ≥ 1/3 (or the threshold you're using).

#Example: If 36 out of 100 households are poor, then H = 0.36 as above 

# Calculate intensity (A): average score among the poor


#Intensity (A) – "How poor are the poor?"
#Definition: The average deprivation score among the poor only.

#This tells us how many weighted indicators, on average, poor people are deprived in.

#Range: Between the poverty cutoff (e.g. 33.3%) and 100%.

#Example: If poor households, on average, are deprived in 50% of the total weight, 
#then A = 0.50 or 50%.

main$mpi_intensity <- mean(main$mpi_score[main$mpi_poor], na.rm = TRUE)

table(main$mpi_intensity)

###Calculate final MPI

main$mpi <- main$mpi_incidence * main$mpi_intensity

#MPI Value (H × A) – "How intense and widespread is poverty?"
#Definition: The final Multidimensional Poverty Index score.

#It combines the incidence and the intensity, showing the overall burden of 
#multidimensional poverty in the population which is 16%


# Group by Intro_07 and calculate the metrics
mpi_results <- main %>%
  group_by(Intro_07) %>%
  summarise(
    mpi_incidence = mean(mpi_score >= 1/3, na.rm = TRUE),
    mpi_intensity = mean(mpi_score[mpi_score >= 1/3], na.rm = TRUE),
    mpi = mpi_incidence * mpi_intensity
  )

# View the results
print(mpi_results)


mpi_results_strata <- main %>%
  filter(!is.na(Intro_07)) %>%
  group_by(samp_strat) %>%
  summarise(
    mpi_incidence = mean(mpi_score >= 1/3, na.rm = TRUE),
    mpi_intensity = mean(mpi_score[mpi_score >= 1/3], na.rm = TRUE),
    mpi = mpi_incidence * mpi_intensity
  )

print(mpi_results_strata)

FDS_XXX_202X_main <- main %>%
  filter(!is.na(wgh_samp_pop_restr)) %>%
  as_survey_design(
    strata=samp_strat,
    weights = wgh_samp_pop_restr, # Specify the column with survey weights
    nest = TRUE              # Use TRUE if PSUs are nested within clusters )
  )

### Percentages of people who are deprived in each indicator 
deprivation_percentages <- FDS_XXX_202X_main %>%
  filter(!is.na(Intro_07)) %>%
  group_by(Intro_07) %>%
  summarise(
    schooling_any      = survey_mean(mpi_edu_schooling_any, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    notattending_any   = survey_mean(mpi_edu_notattending_any, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    antenatal_any      = survey_mean(health_antenatal_mpi_any, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    food_any           = survey_mean(mpi_foodunder, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    nodrinkingwater    = survey_mean(mpi_nodrinkingwater, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    noimprovedtoilet   = survey_mean(mpi_noimprovedtoilet, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    noimprovedwalls    = survey_mean(mpi_housing, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    noelectricity      = survey_mean(mpi_noelectricity, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    solidcooking       = survey_mean(mpi_solidcooking, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    assets             = survey_mean(mpi_assets, na.rm = TRUE) * 100
  )

deprivation_percentages_renamed <- deprivation_percentages %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    `Years of schooling`  = schooling_any,
    `School attendance`   = notattending_any,
    `Antenatal care`      = antenatal_any,
    `Undernourishment`    = food_any,
    `Clean Water`         = nodrinkingwater,
    `Sanitation`          = noimprovedtoilet,
    `Housing`             = noimprovedwalls,
    `Electricity`         = noelectricity,
    `Cooking fuel`        = solidcooking,
    `Assets`              = assets
  )


 deprivation_long <- deprivation_percentages_renamed %>%
   select(-ends_with("_se")) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -Intro_07,
    names_to = "Indicator",
    values_to = "Percentage"
  )

MPIdep <- ggplot(deprivation_long, aes(x = Indicator, y = Percentage/100, fill = Intro_07)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +
  labs(
    x = "",
    y = "",
    fill = ""
  ) +
  theme_unhcr(grid = "Y", axis = "X") +
  scale_fill_unhcr_d() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1.1), expand = c(0, 0), labels = scales::percent) 

###contribution of each deprivation


# Group by Intro_07 and calculate the mean of each weighted deprivation
contributions <- FDS_XXX_202X_main %>%
  filter(!is.na(Intro_07)) %>%
  group_by(Intro_07) %>%
  summarise(
    edu_schooling = survey_mean(edu_schooling, na.rm = TRUE),
    edu_attendance = survey_mean(edu_attendance, na.rm = TRUE),
    health_antenatal = survey_mean(health_antenatal, na.rm = TRUE),
    health_foodunder = survey_mean(health_foodunder, na.rm = TRUE),
    nodrinkingwater = survey_mean(nodrinkingwater, na.rm = TRUE),
    noimprovedtoilet = survey_mean(noimprovedtoilet, na.rm = TRUE),
    noimprovedwalls = survey_mean(noimprovedwalls, na.rm = TRUE),
    noelectricity = survey_mean(noelectricity, na.rm = TRUE),
    solidcooking = survey_mean(solidcooking, na.rm = TRUE),
    assets = survey_mean(assets, na.rm = TRUE)
  )


# Normalize the contributions within each Intro_07 group
contributions_normalized <- contributions %>%
  mutate(across(-Intro_07, ~ . / rowSums(contributions[, -1]) * 100))
contributions_long <- contributions_normalized %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -Intro_07, names_to = "Indicator", values_to = "Contribution")

ggplot(contributions_long, aes(x = Intro_07, y = Contribution, fill = Indicator)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "fill") +  # 100% stacked bar
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(
    title = "Proportional Contribution of Deprivation Indicators by Area",
    x = "",
    y = "Percentage Contribution",
    fill = "Deprivation Indicator"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +  # Use a safe base theme
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold")
  )

###Overall results


#### 1. Incidence (H) – "How many are poor?"
#Definition: The proportion of people (or households) who are multidimensionally poor.
#A person is poor if their weighted deprivation score is ≥ 1/3 (or the threshold you're using).

#Example: If 36 out of 100 households are poor, then H = 0.36 as above 

# Calculate intensity (A): average score among the poor


#Intensity (A) – "How poor are the poor?"
#Definition: The average deprivation score among the poor only.

#This tells us how many weighted indicators, on average, poor people are deprived in.

#Range: Between the poverty cutoff (e.g. 33.3%) and 100%.

#Example: If poor households, on average, are deprived in 50% of the total weight, 
#then A = 0.50 or 50%.

main$mpi_intensity <- mean(main$mpi_score[main$mpi_poor], na.rm = TRUE)

table(main$mpi_intensity)

###Calculate final MPI

main$mpi <- main$mpi_incidence * main$mpi_intensity

#MPI Value (H × A) – "How intense and widespread is poverty?"
#Definition: The final Multidimensional Poverty Index score.

#It combines the incidence and the intensity, showing the overall burden of 
#multidimensional poverty in the population which is 16%


# Group by Intro_07 and calculate the metrics

mpi_results <- FDS_XXX_202X_main %>%
  filter(!is.na(Intro_07)) %>%
  group_by(Intro_07) %>%
  summarise(
    mpi_incidence = survey_mean(mpi_score >= 1/3, na.rm = TRUE),
    mpi_intensity = survey_mean(if_else(mpi_score >= 1/3, mpi_score, NA_real_), na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(mpi = mpi_incidence * mpi_intensity)


# View the results
print(mpi_results)

  filter(!is.na(wgh_samp_pop_restr)) %>%
  as_survey_design(

    weights = wgh_samp_pop_restr, # Specify the column with survey weights
    nest = TRUE              # Use TRUE if PSUs are nested within clusters )
  )


FDS_XXX_202X_main_strat <- main %>%
  filter(!is.na(wgh_strata_spec)) %>%
  as_survey_design(
    strata=samp_strat,
    weights = wgh_strata_spec, # Specify the column with survey weights
    nest = TRUE              # Use TRUE if PSUs are nested within clusters )

mpi_results_strata <- FDS_XXX_202X_main_strat %>%
  filter(!is.na(Intro_07)) %>%
  group_by(samp_strat) %>%
  summarise(
    mpi_incidence = survey_mean(mpi_score >= 1/3, na.rm = TRUE),
    mpi_intensity = survey_mean(if_else(mpi_score >= 1/3, mpi_score, NA_real_), na.rm = TRUE),
    mpi = mpi_incidence * mpi_intensity
  )


# Combine tables
MPI_intro <- mpi_results %>%
  mutate(group = Intro_07, type = "Intro_07") %>%
  filter(Intro_07 == "Refugees") |>
  mutate(group = case_when(Intro_07 == "Refugees" ~ "Refugees total", TRUE ~ Intro_07)) |>
  select(group, type, mpi_incidence) 

MPI_strata <- mpi_results_strata %>%
  mutate(group = samp_strat, type = "Strata") %>%
  select(group, type, mpi_incidence)

# Bind into one dataframe
MPI_combined <- bind_rows(MPI_strata, MPI_intro)

# Make sure Intro_07 groups appear last in the plot
MPI_combined <- MPI_combined %>%
mutate(refugee_host = case_when(                                    
  grepl("Former Refugees", group) ~ "Former Refugees",
  grepl("Refugees", group) ~ "Refugees",
  grepl("Host", group) ~ "Host Community",
  TRUE ~ NA_character_
)) %>%
  mutate(group = factor(group, levels = strat_order))




# Plot

library(ggtext)

plots_wb$MPIstrata <- MPI_combined |>
  ggplot(aes(
    x = fct_rev(group),
    y = mpi_incidence,
    fill = fct_rev(refugee_host)
  )) +
  geom_col(width = 0.6) +
  geom_text(aes(label = scales::percent(mpi_incidence, accuracy = 1)),
            hjust = -0.1, size = 3) +
  coord_flip(clip = "off") +
  scale_y_continuous(
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15)),
    labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)
  ) +
  scale_fill_unhcr_d(labels = c("Strata" = "Strata", "Intro_07" = "Population Groups")) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) stringr::str_wrap(x, 30)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = NULL) +
  theme_unhcr(grid = "X", axis = "Y")

# Group by Intro_07 and calculate the percentages for each indicator

    schooling_any = survey_mean(mpi_edu_schooling_any, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,

    noimprovedtoilet = survey_mean(mpi_noimprovedtoilet, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    noimprovedwalls = survey_mean(mpi_housing, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    noelectricity = survey_mean(mpi_noelectricity, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,

  )

# Rename and reorder columns
deprivation_percentages_strat_renamed <- deprivation_percentages_strat %>%

    `Sanitation` = noimprovedtoilet,
    `Housing Materials` = noimprovedwalls,
    `Electricity` = noelectricity,
    `Cooking fuel` = solidcooking,
    `Assets` = assets
  )

# Start from your renamed table

  select(-ends_with("_se")) %>%

  )

  "disability_HoH", "hhhead_literacy", "hhhead_primary", "ScProtec01_bin"

# Function to calculate MPI incidence by variable and Intro_07
get_mpi_table <- function(df, var) {
  df %>%
    mutate(mpi_poor = mpi_score >= 1/3) %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[var]]), !is.na(Intro_07)) %>%
    group_by(Intro_07, .data[[var]]) %>%
    summarise(
      Total = n(),
      Poor = survey_total(mpi_poor, na.rm = TRUE),
      `MPI incidence (%)` = round(survey_mean(mpi_poor, na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 1),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    rename(Category = 2, `Population Groups` = Intro_07)
}

# Apply function to all variables and bind rows
big_mpi_table <- map_dfr(vars, ~ get_mpi_table(FDS_XXX_202X_main, .x))

# Display the table
mpitypologytable <- kableExtra::kable(
  big_mpi_table,
  caption = "MPI Incidence by Household Characteristics and Population Group",
  digits = 1
)
```
